$comment: The remedy table of diagnostics (E50.10, #980): one entry per code a diagnostic stage or a connection test can return. The API returns codes only; the web app and the CLI render these words. `who`: who can fix it (`owner` or `admin`). `link` (optional): where to fix it (`settings`: the owner's Connections page; `admin`: Administration; `provider_console`: the provider's own console; `web_search`: the owner's Web search settings). apps/api/test/diagnostics.spec.ts fails when a code a stage can return has no entry here. Plain words; never a provider's message.

CONNECTION_PAUSED.title: Paused
CONNECTION_PAUSED.remedy: Nothing uses this connection while it is paused. Resume it to use it again.

CONNECTION_NEEDS_RECONNECT.title: Needs to be connected again
CONNECTION_NEEDS_RECONNECT.remedy: The service no longer accepts this connection's sign-in. Connect the account again.

GRANT_REVOKED.title: The access was withdrawn
GRANT_REVOKED.remedy: The access was revoked or expired at the service (a password change, a removed app, an expired test grant). Connect the account again.

NO_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: The sign-in cannot be renewed
NO_REFRESH_TOKEN.remedy: The service did not give a way to stay signed in. Connect the account again.

TOKEN_STORE_FAILED.title: The sign-in could not be saved
TOKEN_STORE_FAILED.remedy: The console could not store the renewed sign-in. Connect the account again; if it happens again, tell your administrator.

AUTH_REFUSED.title: The sign-in was refused
AUTH_REFUSED.remedy: The server refused the sign-in it was given. Reconnect it with a valid token or sign in again.

NO_SECRET.title: The saved token is missing
NO_SECRET.remedy: The token or header value saved for this server is gone. Reconnect it with the token.

NOT_INSTALLED.title: Not installed here
NOT_INSTALLED.remedy: This kind of connection is not installed on this deployment. Ask your administrator.

PROVIDER_DISABLED.title: Switched off here
PROVIDER_DISABLED.remedy: Your administrator switched this kind of connection off for this deployment.

APP_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: The administrator's app is not set up
APP_NOT_CONFIGURED.remedy: The deployment's app at the provider is missing its client id or secret. Ask your administrator to finish the setup.

APP_REFUSED.title: The provider refused the deployment's app
APP_REFUSED.remedy: The provider no longer accepts the deployment's app (a changed or expired client secret). Ask your administrator to check it.

REFUSED.title: The provider refused the request
REFUSED.remedy: The provider refused to renew the sign-in. Try again later; if it keeps failing, connect the account again.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The provider could not be reached
UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The service did not answer or answered with an error. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: The sign-in was refused
UNAUTHORIZED.remedy: The service did not accept the sign-in. Test again; if it still fails, connect the account again.

FORBIDDEN.title: The provider refused: the permission is missing
FORBIDDEN.remedy: The account signed in but is not allowed to do this. Use "Change what it can do" to ask for the permission again.

PERMISSION_MISSING.title: A permission is missing
PERMISSION_MISSING.remedy: The provider did not grant a permission this capability needs (the report names the capability). Use "Change what it can do" on the connection, sign in again and tick that permission on the provider's consent screen.

CAPABILITY_OFF.title: Switched off for this account
CAPABILITY_OFF.remedy: This capability is switched off for this connection. Switch it on if you want it used.

API_DISABLED.title: The service is switched off in the administrator's app
API_DISABLED.remedy: The API this capability uses is not enabled in the deployment's project at the provider. Ask your administrator to enable it.

NO_MAILBOX.title: This account has no mailbox
NO_MAILBOX.remedy: The account has no mailbox the service can read (for example a personal account without mail, or one not licensed for it). Switch Mail off for it, or connect another account.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found at the provider
NOT_FOUND.remedy: The service answered that the resource this check reads does not exist for this account.

FAILED.title: Failed
FAILED.remedy: The service answered in a way the console did not expect. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Asked to slow down
RATE_LIMITED.remedy: The service asked to slow down. Try again in a minute.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: Quota used up
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.remedy: The quota at the service is used up. It resets later; your administrator may raise it at the provider.

MCP_PROTOCOL.title: Not an MCP server
MCP_PROTOCOL.remedy: The server did not answer in the MCP protocol this console speaks (Streamable HTTP). Check the address.

RPC.title: The server answered with an error
RPC.remedy: The server answered the request with an error. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact whoever runs the server.

REDIRECT.title: The server redirected
REDIRECT.remedy: The server answered with a redirect, which is never followed. Use the server's final address.

INVALID_URL.title: Not a valid address
INVALID_URL.remedy: The address is not a valid URL. Check it.

SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Only https is allowed
SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must start with https://.

USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED.title: A user name in the address
USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must not contain a user name or password. Put a token in the sign-in instead.

QUERY_NOT_ALLOWED.title: A query in the address
QUERY_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address must not contain a query or a fragment. Put a token in the sign-in instead.

PORT_NOT_ALLOWED.title: That port is not allowed
PORT_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: The address uses a port this console does not connect to.

PRIVATE_TARGET.title: A private address
PRIVATE_TARGET.remedy: The address points at a private or internal network, which is not allowed.

UNRESOLVABLE.title: The address could not be found
UNRESOLVABLE.remedy: The host name could not be resolved. Check the address, or try again later.

HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.title: The host is not on the allowed list
HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: Your administrator allows only some hosts, and this one is not among them.

TIMEOUT.title: Too slow
TIMEOUT.remedy: The check did not finish in time. Try again in a few minutes.

TOO_LARGE.title: The answer was too large
TOO_LARGE.remedy: The service answered with more than this console reads. Contact whoever runs the service.

NETWORK.title: A network error
NETWORK.remedy: The connection to the service failed. Try again in a few minutes.

ABORTED.title: Stopped
ABORTED.remedy: The check was stopped before it finished. Run it again.

DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.title: Out of time
DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.remedy: The whole check took longer than 20 seconds and the rest was not run. Try again in a few minutes.

SLOW.title: Slow
SLOW.remedy: The checks passed but took more than 5 seconds. The service may be busy; runs that use it may be slow.

PROVIDER_OFF.title: Switched off here
PROVIDER_OFF.remedy: The administrator's switch for this provider is off: nobody can connect it until it is switched on in Administration, Connections. The app can still be tested.

APP_CREDENTIALS_REFUSED.title: The provider refused the app's client id or secret
APP_CREDENTIALS_REFUSED.remedy: The provider does not accept the deployment's client id or client secret (a wrong, deleted or expired secret, or an app that no longer exists). Create a new secret in the provider's console and save it in Administration, Connections.

ADMIN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: An administrator has to approve the app
ADMIN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.remedy: The account's organization requires an administrator to approve this app before anyone can use it. Send the approval link from the Connect dialog to your organization's administrator, then connect again.

REFRESH_STALE.title: Not renewed for a long time
REFRESH_STALE.remedy: The sign-in was last renewed more than 44 hours ago, although the daily job should keep it fresh. It may still work; if the console's jobs are not running, tell your administrator.

CLOCK_SKEW.title: The server's clock is off
CLOCK_SKEW.remedy: The console's clock differs from the provider's by more than two minutes, and sign-ins fail when it drifts further. Set the server to synchronise its clock (NTP).

MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND.title: The account has no mailbox
MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND.remedy: This Microsoft account has no Exchange Online mailbox (it may be a OneDrive-only, on-premises or inactive account). Switch Mail off for it, or connect an account that has a mailbox.

LICENSE_MISSING.title: The account has no licence for this service
LICENSE_MISSING.remedy: The account's organization has not assigned it a licence for this service (Exchange Online for mail, OneDrive for documents). Ask the organization's administrator to assign one, or switch the capability off.

REDIRECT_NOT_HTTPS.title: The redirect address is not https
REDIRECT_NOT_HTTPS.remedy: The address the provider sends people back to must be https (http works only on this machine's own loopback address). Set the console's public address (APP_URL) to its https address and register that redirect address at the provider.

APP_URL_MISMATCH.title: The redirect address is not the one you are on
APP_URL_MISMATCH.remedy: The redirect address the console sends is built from APP_URL, which differs from the address you reached the console on. Set APP_URL to the public address and register the same redirect address in the provider's console.

TENANT_NOT_FOUND.title: The Microsoft tenant does not exist
TENANT_NOT_FOUND.remedy: Microsoft does not know the tenant set for the app. Set the tenant in Administration, Connections to common, organizations, consumers or your directory (tenant) id from the Azure portal.

NEEDS_A_SIGN_IN.title: Can only be checked by connecting
NEEDS_A_SIGN_IN.remedy: The provider's answer does not tell whether the client id and secret are accepted. Connect a test account to check them.

PICKER_KEY_MISSING.title: The file picker has no API key
PICKER_KEY_MISSING.remedy: Owners cannot pick Google files in the picker until a browser API key is saved: in Google Cloud, APIs & Services, Credentials, create an API key restricted to the Google Picker API and this console's address, and save it in Administration, Connections. Files can still be used by their link.

API_DISABLED_GMAIL.title: The Gmail API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_GMAIL.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, Gmail API, Enable. Then test again.

API_DISABLED_CALENDAR.title: The Google Calendar API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_CALENDAR.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, Google Calendar API, Enable. Then test again.

API_DISABLED_DRIVE.title: The Google Drive API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_DRIVE.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, Google Drive API, Enable. Documents also need the Google Docs API and the Google Sheets API. Then test again.

API_DISABLED_DOCS.title: The Google Docs API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_DOCS.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, Google Docs API, Enable. Then test again.

API_DISABLED_SHEETS.title: The Google Sheets API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_SHEETS.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, Google Sheets API, Enable. Then test again.

API_DISABLED_PEOPLE.title: The People API is not enabled
API_DISABLED_PEOPLE.remedy: In the Google Cloud project that owns the deployment's sign-in client: APIs & Services, Library, People API, Enable. Then test again.

SEARCH_OFF.title: Web search is switched off
SEARCH_OFF.remedy: Your administrator switched web search off for this deployment; the agent searches in the browser instead.

SEARCH_OFF_BY_YOU.title: You switched web search off
SEARCH_OFF_BY_YOU.remedy: Web search is off in your own settings; the agent searches in the browser instead. Switch it on to use it.

SEARCH_PROVIDER_OFF.title: This search provider is switched off
SEARCH_PROVIDER_OFF.remedy: The administrator switched this search provider off. Another provider in the order may still answer.

NOT_IN_ORDER.title: Not in the provider order
NOT_IN_ORDER.remedy: This provider is not listed in the deployment's order, so searches never use it. Add it to the order in Administration → Web search.

KEY_MISSING.title: No key to search with
KEY_MISSING.remedy: No key you may use is set for this provider. Add your own key in your Web search settings, or ask your administrator to share one.

DEPLOYMENT_KEY_MISSING.title: No deployment key
DEPLOYMENT_KEY_MISSING.remedy: The deployment has no key for this provider. Set one in Administration → Web search, or leave it to each user's own key.

DEPLOYMENT_KEY_NOT_SHARED.title: The deployment key is not shared
DEPLOYMENT_KEY_NOT_SHARED.remedy: The deployment's key works but users may not use it: each needs their own key. Switch on sharing in Administration → Web search if everyone should use it.

USER_KEYS_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Your own key is not allowed here
USER_KEYS_NOT_ALLOWED.remedy: Your administrator does not allow users' own search keys on this deployment, so the key you saved is not used.

SECRETS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.title: The key could not be read
SECRETS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The place your key is kept (the credential store or your secrets provider) did not answer. Try again; if it keeps failing, check Settings → Secrets.

MODEL_NOT_CHOSEN.title: No model chosen
MODEL_NOT_CHOSEN.remedy: This search provider answers through AI, but AI is off, has no key, or no model is chosen for it. Your administrator sets it up in Administration → AI.

ADDRESS_MISSING.title: No address set
ADDRESS_MISSING.remedy: This self-hosted search provider has no address. Your administrator sets it in Administration → Web search.

TLS_FAILED.title: The secure connection failed
TLS_FAILED.remedy: The server's certificate was not accepted (expired, self-signed or for another name). Fix the certificate or the address.

SEARCH_PRIVATE_TARGET.title: A private address
SEARCH_PRIVATE_TARGET.remedy: The provider's address points at a private or internal network, which the console does not call. Use a public address.

SEARCH_KEY_REFUSED.title: The provider refused the key
SEARCH_KEY_REFUSED.remedy: The search provider did not accept the key (wrong, revoked or for another plan). Replace the key where it is set.

SEARCH_RATE_LIMITED.title: The provider asked to slow down
SEARCH_RATE_LIMITED.remedy: The search provider is limiting requests for this key. Try again in a minute; frequent limits mean the plan is too small.

SEARCH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: The key's quota is used up
SEARCH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.remedy: The plan of this key at the search provider has no searches left this period. It resets later, or raise the plan at the provider.

SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE.title: The search provider did not answer
SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The search provider answered with an error or not at all. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes.

FORMAT_DISABLED.title: The JSON answer is switched off
FORMAT_DISABLED.remedy: The self-hosted search server does not answer in JSON. Enable the json format in its settings (search.formats).

NO_RESULTS.title: No results
NO_RESULTS.remedy: The test search answered but found nothing for a common word. The provider may be misconfigured; searches may come back empty.

LIMIT_REACHED.title: Today's limit is reached
LIMIT_REACHED.remedy: You used today's web search limit; the test search was not sent. It resets at midnight UTC, or your administrator raises it.

LIMIT_NEAR.title: Today's limit is nearly reached
LIMIT_NEAR.remedy: More than 80% of today's web search limit is used. It resets at midnight UTC, or your administrator raises it.

FETCH_OFF.title: Reading pages is switched off
FETCH_OFF.remedy: The agent cannot read pages on the server (web_fetch is off); it opens them in the browser instead. Your administrator switches it on in Administration → Web search.

BLOCKED.title: The page is blocked
BLOCKED.remedy: The console's rules refused to read the test page (a blocked host or a private address). Check the blocked hosts in Administration → Web search.

FETCH_UNAVAILABLE.title: The test page could not be read
FETCH_UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The console could not read a well-known public page from the server. The server may have no internet access, or a proxy blocks it.

UNKNOWN.title: Failed
UNKNOWN.remedy: Something failed that the console has no words for. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
